method: Inspected all 100 named case summaries, birth dates and encounter ages, facility/care boundaries, dispositions and declared shortage causes; sixty cases cover the thirty stockout and thirty circulating-RN absence windows.

Read detailed operative, medication, actual worker, source knowledge, dose/base-unit, lot/expiry and daily consumption examples, including cases 1-4, 62-64, 75 and 100. Shift and daily stock-group costs remain explicitly distinct from patient charges.

Inspected retained labor publications, changed planned/actual durations, absence and cancellation histories, paid leave, rate corrections and open attendance; reviewed expiry, unopened returns, cycle-count assertions and their linked reversal histories.

Reviewed workload/competency assumptions and selected capture limits. Full data controls, independent persisted inspection and process-recovery regressions must pass separately; plausibility review is conditional on that technical gate.

resolved_findings.resolution: Link actual medication/observation nurses and operative surgeons to qualified attendance. Preserve the specialty-qualified attending of record and distinguish source reviewing authors from full service performers.

Use actual coordinated case-list lanes, prohibit surgeon overlap, and require actual circulating-RN coverage for concurrent cases. Staff absence and stock readiness change actual procedure start/end and source clocks within observed care boundaries.

Generate retained initial nursing rosters using lagged source-known census, record forecast cancellations, and treat missing early source versions as unknown. No final actual hours or costs appear in advance publications.
Recompute costs from serialized six-place paid hours, split workweeks with an explicit micro-hour residual, apply the loaded rate once and append retroactive rate/attendance corrections.
Exclude stock expiring within procurement lead time from reorder availability; independently replay actual FEFO eligibility, whole medication fills, receipts and expiry at point of use.
Attach two prior recorded patient assessments with exact facts and availability to each resource note; bound normalized prose duplication and prohibit unsupported future-outcome assertions.
Use stable logical-shift ordering for recurring-decimal nursing prorations so serialized and in-memory validation reproduce identical controls without altering business facts.

material_assumptions: Fictional adult Illinois hospital network and selected care/resource capture. This is not a safe-staffing standard, real payroll calculation or licensed clinical endorsement.

Staff source history captures all modeled worked blocks plus selected earlier publications, support samples, leave and corrections. It is not complete hospital payroll, continuous EVS coverage, an entire OR/anesthetic team or all clinician activity.

The pharmacy stock pool is facility-level. Selected serum collection, preparation, gloves, drapes and precaution gowns do not represent every material, implant, anesthetic or blood product used in care.

Medication issues are single-lot indivisible administrations or whole prescription fills. Residual lots remain available to smaller fills. Daily book issues are batch source facts and do not assert a live ward cabinet inventory.

Prewindow clinical context remains observed context without invented opening resource expense. Closing unfinished attendance has observed start and zero finalized cost; later costing requires a separate explicit accrual policy.
Source cost inputs are not patient-level allocated costs or financial postings. Finance, Axiom scenarios, source release replay and final consumer acceptance remain future phases.
disposition: Synthetic resource plausibility approved for the reviewed content, conditional on all Phase 5 technical exit criteria passing. Full release and healthcare analytics solution remain blocked until Phase 9.
